title: E0069: Unsafe deserialization
plain_english: Passing untrusted data to `unserialize()` or similar deserialization functions can instantiate arbitrary PHP objects and trigger magic methods such as `__wakeup()` and `__destruct()`.
why_matters: PHP object injection is a critical vulnerability. A crafted serialized payload can: - Trigger magic methods when unserialized - Execute code through gadget chains in loaded classes - Read, modify, or delete files - Lead to remote code execution
what_it_checks: `unserialize()` calls with tainted input from `$_GET`, `$_POST`, `$_REQUEST`, `$_COOKIE`, or `php://input`
